research_question: Does a counterbalanced fabricated block assignment lift the structural interpretation ceiling to a causal candidate while still requiring review and replication?
hypothesis: A within-driver, block-level baseline/intervention contrast over one verified segment can be built, analysed, and preserved deterministically.
null_hypothesis: The declared contrast cannot be constructed comparably, or the result cannot be reproduced from the bound evidence.

independent_variable.name: block-condition
independent_variable.operational_definition: Each contiguous fabricated block is labelled either the baseline condition or the intervention condition before any value is inspected.

primary_dependent_metric.definition: Lowest speed observed inside the declared segment on one lap.

secondary_metrics.definition: Along-lap distance at which brake pressure was last at or above the declared threshold inside the segment.

controlled_variables: Driver, simulator, car, track, and layout are held fixed across blocks
Segment definition and metric definition are frozen before construction
Normalization contract and adapter version are held fixed
Fingerprint-bound setup/configuration and product-build identities are held fixed
Block labelling is fixed before any value is inspected
comparability_requirements: Compare only within one verified segment geometry on one layout
Use within-driver pairing across blocks of the same participant
Do not pool blocks whose condition the protocol does not assign to a declared arm
Treat the block as the level at which the condition varies
Refuse pooling when setup/configuration or product-build identity differs or is unavailable
exclusion_criteria: Records positioned outside the declared segment region
Records whose metric channel is absent or explicitly unavailable
Records belonging to a lap the source marked invalid
Records carrying an incident or off-track state
Records carrying a pit, replay, or discontinuity quality flag
Units below the declared minimum record count or concept-coverage ratio

requirements: At least 4 comparable within-driver pairs and at least 2 blocks for a mechanics-level contrast
At least 12 comparable within-driver pairs and at least 4 blocks before any confirmatory interpretation of a real corpus
minimum_sample_requirements.rationale: These are deliberately modest fabricated-demonstration thresholds. They are software requirements for exercising the sufficiency gate, not a scientific power calculation, and no real campaign may inherit them.

baseline_condition: A fabricated block collected without the declared intervention.
intervention_conditions: A fabricated block collected with the declared intervention applied for its full duration
randomization_counterbalancing: Block order is counterbalanced across the fabricated session using a frozen schedule, so order and condition are not confounded.
analysis_methods: Report attrition and robust descriptive summaries before any contrast
Estimate the paired difference at the declared experimental unit
Resample whole blocks rather than nested laps when forming an interval
Run the declared leave-one-out and order-effect falsification checks
Apply the declared familywise correction across the declared comparison family

criteria: The evidence set is reproducible from its declared inputs
The paired estimate, its interval, and its sensitivity results are reproducible from the bound evidence
falsification_criteria: The direction of the paired estimate is carried by a single unit
The result cannot be reproduced from the bound evidence and code

safety_constraints: Use only fabricated data with no real driver, customer, simulator, or production source
Never infer racing performance from this protocol
notes: This protocol exists only to demonstrate that a counterbalanced design with predeclared criteria reaches the causal_candidate ceiling.
A causal candidate is still a candidate: it requires scientific review and independent replication, and synthetic evidence can never be promoted.
